definitions.explanation: Of a face: strongly modeled, with a high nose bridge and deep-set eyes, as if carved. Usually said with admiration, and often of people who look Western or of mixed descent; the opposite is a flat, smooth face.

examples.japanese: {彫|ほ}りが{深|ふか}い⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{彫|ほ}りが{深|ふか}くて⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: She has deep-set features and big eyes.

examples.japanese: {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えられる→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: With his chiseled features, he is sometimes taken for a foreigner.

notes:
As a modifier it is often {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ → ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧): {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧. {彫|ほ}り is literally "carving".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彫|ほ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧: chiseled features
- {彫|ほ}りが{深|ふか}い⟦{目元|めもと}→目元：23407_memoto⟧: deep-set eyes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目鼻立|めはなだ}ち→目鼻立ち：33068_mehanadachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきりしている→はっきりする：26886_hakkirisuru⟧: having clear, well-defined features
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{平|たい}ら→平ら：03399_taira⟧ / のっぺり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a flat, smooth face (the opposite)
- ⟦{端正|たんせい}→端正：14887_tansei⟧: handsome and regular — about proportion, not depth
